method_note: Body search on a help forum drowns: Cursor's own model-inheritance feature makes "inherited" useless as a marker, and a first pass built on it was discarded. The pass that worked searched TITLES, because on a Q&A forum a person in the shape we need announces it in the title.
limits: Every venue here is a place people go when something is wrong or unclear, so it over-samples friction and under-samples people for whom it works.
No receiver speaks in the first person even here. Every team-sharing thread is written by the sender.
Rule 5 governs all of it: these are utterances.

third_pass.why: The remaining cells, and one deliberate inversion of the method.

instruments_added.name: GitHub issues on the public collections themselves
instruments_added.what: 568 issues across 18 of the largest public skill/agent collections and installer tools. The premise: somebody who turns up at a stranger's shelf and asks a question is P3-shaped by construction.
instruments_added.blind_to: whether the asker has material of their own - which turned out to be the whole problem

third_pass.conclusion: The blocker on the remaining cells is persona attribution, not evidence. A public artefact shows an act; a persona is defined by a situation. P2's five and P3's ten are waiting for somebody to be asked.
third_pass.self_check: H-J7 was filled at 2 rather than 3 on purpose. All four voices also built and shipped software about it, which looks like the test for a 3 - but they were found on Show HN, where having built something is the entry ticket, so counting the building as importance is circular. Their posts scored 1, 2, 2 and 3 points, so the venue's own weighting is worth nothing either.
